indicator.name: Buffett Indicator
indicator.description: U.S. listed equity market capitalization as a percentage of nominal GDP.
indicator.source_name: World Bank (market capitalization of listed domestic companies / GDP)
indicator.methodology: Market capitalization of listed domestic companies as a percentage of GDP, as published by the World Bank from World Federation of Exchanges data. The series is shown as supplementary evidence and carries zero weight in the composite.
indicator.limitations: Annual frequency with a substantial publication lag. Coverage is listed domestic companies, not every U.S.-listed issuer, and U.S. companies earn significant revenue abroad. It is supplementary evidence, not a timing tool or a fourth valuation vote.
